subject: math
question: 求空间曲线 $\Gamma: \begin{cases} x^2 + y^2 = z \\ y = x \tan z \end{cases}$ 从原点到第一卦限中的点 $(a, b, c)$ 的一段弧长.
answer: L = \int_ {\Gamma} d s = \int_ {0} ^ {c} \frac {2 z + 1}{2 \sqrt {z}} d z = \frac {1}{3} \sqrt {c} (3 + 2 c).

steps.text: 分析 曲线弧长为 $\int_{\Gamma} \mathrm{d}s$ ，关键是要求得 $\mathrm{d}s$ 的一元表达式。为此可将曲线方程参数化，或由 $\Gamma$ 的方程通过微分运算来得到。

方法1 取曲线的参数方程 $x = \sqrt{z}\cos z, y = \sqrt{z}\sin z, z = z$ ，则

$$
x _ {z} = \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {z}} \cos z - \sqrt {z} \sin z, y _ {z} = \frac {1}{2 \sqrt {z}} \sin z + \sqrt {z} \cos z, z _ {z} = 1.
$$

弧长微元为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \mathrm{d} s = \sqrt {1 + (x _ {z}) ^ {2} + (y _ {z}) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} z = \sqrt {1 + \left(\frac {1}{2 \sqrt {z}} \cos z - \sqrt {z} \sin z\right) ^ {2} + \left(\frac {1}{2 \sqrt {z}} \sin z + \sqrt {z} \cos z\right) ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} z \\ = \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{4 z} + z} \mathrm{d} z = \sqrt {\frac {1 + 4 z + 4 z ^ {2}}{4 z}} \mathrm{d} z = \frac {2 z + 1}{2 \sqrt {z}} \mathrm{d} z. \end{array}
$$

所求弧长为

$$
L = \int_ {\Gamma} d s = \int_ {0} ^ {c} \frac {2 z + 1}{2 \sqrt {z}} d z = \frac {1}{3} \sqrt {c} (3 + 2 c).
$$

方法2 曲线方程变形为 $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} x^2 + y^2 = z \\ \arctan \frac{y}{x} = z \end{array} \right.$ ，两边求微分得

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 2 x \mathrm{d} x + 2 y \mathrm{d} y = \mathrm{d} z \\ \frac {x \mathrm{d} y - y \mathrm{d} x}{x ^ {2} + y ^ {2}} = \mathrm{d} z \end{array} \right. \xrightarrow {x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} = z} (\mathrm{d} x) ^ {2} + (\mathrm{d} y) ^ {2} = \left(\frac {1}{4 z} + z\right) (\mathrm{d} z) ^ {2},

\mathrm{d} s = \sqrt {(\mathrm{d} x) ^ {2} + (\mathrm{d} y) ^ {2} + (\mathrm{d} z) ^ {2}} = \sqrt {1 + \frac {1}{4 z} + z} \mathrm{d} z \quad (\text {后略}).
$$

solution.final_answer: L = \int_ {\Gamma} d s = \int_ {0} ^ {c} \frac {2 z + 1}{2 \sqrt {z}} d z = \frac {1}{3} \sqrt {c} (3 + 2 c).
